es: Presentar un gráfico de la liga escolar y responder a las preguntas del público con datos, cautela y una limitación reconocida.

teaching.en: Good morning, everyone. I will briefly walk through the results of the school league, and then we will open the floor to the audience.
teaching.es: Buenos días a todos. Explicaré brevemente los resultados de la liga escolar y después daremos la palabra al público.
teaching.explanationEs: Saludo + I will briefly walk through…: anuncias de qué vas a hablar y cuánto durará; open the floor invita al público a intervenir.
segments: Good morning, everyone. I will briefly walk through the results of the

teaching.audioText: Good morning, everyone. I will briefly walk through the results of the school league, and then we will open the floor to the audience.

teaching.en: On this slide, the green line will illustrate the trend, and I'd like to highlight the peak in May, when the league drew its biggest crowd.
teaching.es: En esta diapositiva, la línea verde ilustrará la tendencia, y me gustaría destacar el punto máximo de mayo, cuando la liga reunió a más público.
teaching.explanationEs: On this slide guía la mirada; I'd like to + verbo base introduce lo que quieres destacar.
segments: On this slide, the green line will illustrate the trend, and I'd like
to highlight the peak in May, when the league drew its biggest crowd.

teaching.en: Let me clarify: the figures cover only the first term, so this is only part of the picture, and I want to draw attention to that point.
teaching.es: Permítanme aclarar: las cifras cubren solo el primer trimestre, así que esto es solo una parte del panorama, y quiero llamar la atención sobre ese punto.
teaching.explanationEs: Let me clarify precisa qué abarcan los datos antes de que el público saque conclusiones; draw attention to + sustantivo señala algo importante.
segments: Let me clarify: the figures cover only the first term, so this is only
part of the picture, and I want to draw attention to that point.
teaching.audioText: Let me clarify: the figures cover only the first term, so this is only part of the picture, and I want to draw attention to that point.

teaching.en: That is a fair question. The data suggest a link, but I can't say that it is the cause, and I would not want to overstate what the figures show.
teaching.es: Es una pregunta razonable. Los datos sugieren un vínculo, pero no puedo decir que sea la causa, y no quisiera exagerar lo que muestran las cifras.
teaching.explanationEs: Primero valida la pregunta (fair question), luego responde con datos y con la cautela de las clases anteriores.
segments: That is a fair question. The data suggest a link, but I can't say that
it is the cause, and I would not want to overstate what the figures show.
teaching.audioText: That is a fair question. The data suggest a link, but I can't say that it is the cause, and I would not want to overstate what the figures show.

teaching.en: One limitation is that the sample is small, so the audience should treat the projection with care, and I welcome any question about the method.
teaching.es: Una limitación es que la muestra es pequeña, así que el público debería tomar la proyección con cuidado, y agradezco cualquier pregunta sobre el método.
teaching.explanationEs: One limitation is that… reconoce un límite de los datos; es una señal de honestidad, no de debilidad.

prompt.es: Elige la apertura más adecuada para presentar los resultados ante el público.

choices.text: Hey, so, well, here is some stuff about the teams and the numbers, I guess.
Good morning. Everything on this slide proves that our league is the best one.
Good morning, everyone. I will briefly walk through the results of our league.

feedback.es: Una buena apertura saluda, anuncia el plan y mantiene un tono profesional; las otras opciones son demasiado informales o exageran.

hint.es: Busca el saludo profesional que anuncia qué vas a hacer, sin exagerar.

origin.text: You have five minutes to present the league results to parents and teachers. Your first slide shows the number of teams in each of the last four years, and the audience has not seen the figures before.

prompt.es: Completa: «En esta diapositiva, la línea verde ilustrará la tendencia.»

feedback.es: Illustrate significa mostrar algo con un ejemplo o un gráfico; la línea verde ilustra la tendencia que vas a explicar.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa mostrar algo con un gráfico o un ejemplo.

origin.text: Please look at the screen. On this slide, the green line will ___ the trend: the number of teams rose steadily from 12 to 24.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Déjenme aclarar que las cifras cubren solo el primer trimestre.»

answer.text: Let me clarify that the figures cover only the first term

feedback.es: Let me clarify + that… precisa el alcance de los datos antes de que el público saque conclusiones.

hint.es: Empieza con la fórmula que anuncia una aclaración.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hará la oradora después de explicar el gráfico.

choices.text: Invite the audience to ask about anything that is unclear.
Ask the audience to vote on the future of the club.
Hand out a printed copy of the results to everyone.

feedback.es: La oradora dice que dará la palabra al público (open the floor) para que pregunte lo que quiera que repita.

origin.audio: Good morning, everyone. Today I will briefly walk through the results of our tennis club. On this slide, the orange line illustrates the trend, and I would like to draw attention to the drop in March, when the club lost six members. After that, I will open the floor to questions, so please note down anything you would like me to explain again.

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta más adecuada que puede dar la presentadora.

choices.text: That is a fair question. Yes, the new coach is the reason, because attendance rose right after he arrived.
That is a fair question. The data suggest a link, but I can't say it is the cause yet.
That is not relevant, because the presentation is about the figures and not about the people behind them at all.

feedback.es: Con solo dos temporadas, lo honesto es admitir un vínculo posible sin afirmar la causa.

origin.text: A parent asks: 'You say that attendance rose after the new coach arrived. Does that mean he is the reason?' The presenter's slide shows the attendance for only two seasons.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo responde Mia a la pregunta sobre la pista nueva.

choices.text: With confidence: she says that the court is the main cause.
With doubt: she says that nobody can know if the court mattered.
With caution: she sees a link but refuses to claim a cause.

feedback.es: Mia reconoce que los datos sugieren un vínculo, pero no la llama causa porque el aumento empezó antes de que abriera la pista.

origin.audio: At the end of her talk on the school league, Mia took two questions. A teacher asked whether the league would keep growing, and Mia thanked him for a fair question. She explained that, if the trend continues, the league is likely to reach thirty teams by 2027, but she stressed that this is only an estimate. A parent then asked whether the new court had caused the rise. Mia said that the data suggest a link, but she could not call it the cause, because the increase began before the court opened. Finally, she admitted one limitation: the data cover only four years.

prompt.es: Con el mismo audio, elige por qué Mia menciona al final la limitación de los datos.

choices.text: To be honest about how far her conclusions can go.
To apologise for having chosen the wrong kind of chart.
To avoid having to answer any more questions.

feedback.es: Admitir que los datos cubren solo cuatro años es una muestra de honestidad sobre el alcance de sus conclusiones.

origin.text: Some of you may think that the chart covers the whole year. Let me ___: the figures cover only the first term, so this is only part of the picture.

prompt.es: Presenta el gráfico y responde con cautela a las dos preguntas del público.

answer.text: Good morning, everyone. I will briefly walk through the results of our school league, and then I will open the floor to questions. On this slide, the line illustrates the trend: the number of teams rose steadily from 12 in 2022 to 24 in 2025, so it doubled in three years. I'd like to highlight the jump between 2024 and 2025, when six new teams joined. Someone asked whether the league will keep growing. That is a fair question. If the trend continues, it is likely to reach thirty teams by 2027, but this is only an estimate. Another question was whether the new court caused the rise. The data suggest a link, but I can't say it is the cause, because the increase started earlier. One limitation is that we only have four years of data. Thank you for listening.

Hello, everyone. Today I will briefly present our school league, and afterwards I will take questions. This slide shows that the number of teams grew steadily from 12 in 2022 to 24 in 2025. I would like to draw attention to the last year, when six new teams joined. You asked if the league will keep growing. That is a fair question: it is expected to reach thirty teams by 2027, but that is only an estimate. You also asked about the new court. The figures suggest a link, but I cannot say that the court is the cause, because the rise began before it opened. One limitation is that we have data for only four years. Thank you, and I am happy to answer more questions.

Good afternoon, everyone. I will briefly walk through our league results. On this slide, the number of teams doubled, rising from 12 in 2022 to 24 in 2025, and I'd like to highlight the last year. The first question was whether the league will keep growing. That is a fair question. The trend is projected to continue, so we may reach thirty teams by 2027, although this is only an estimate. The second question was about the new court. The data suggest a link, but I can't say it caused the rise, because teams were already increasing. One limitation is that we only have four years of data, so please take the projection with care. Thank you for listening.

feedback.es: La presentación saluda, describe la tendencia con cifras, responde a las dos preguntas con cautela y reconoce una limitación.

origin.text: Gráfico de la liga escolar. Equipos inscritos: 2022: 12, 2023: 15, 2024: 18, 2025: 24. La cancha nueva se estrenó en 2024. Preguntas del público: 1) «¿Seguirá creciendo la liga?» 2) «¿La cancha nueva es la causa del aumento?» Escribe unas 120 a 220 palabras: saluda y anuncia, describe la tendencia con cifras, responde a las dos preguntas con cautela y menciona una limitación.

prompt.es: Lee el correo de la profesora y elige qué crítica hace a la presentación.

choices.text: That the slides were too clear for the audience to follow them.
That the presenter sounded more certain than the evidence allowed.
That the presenter talked for too long before taking questions.

feedback.es: La profesora alaba las diapositivas y critica la seguridad del presentador respecto a un efecto que solo dos temporadas no pueden probar.

origin.text: Teacher's email: 'Thanks for your presentation. I liked the clear slides, but I was concerned that you seemed very sure about the effect of the new coach when you only had two seasons of data. Next time, say what the figures cannot show.'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué aconseja la colega si alguien cuestiona la proyección.

choices.text: Agree that the projection is wrong and remove the whole slide from the talk.
Promise that the league will double again in the next three years.
Explain that it is only an estimate and what it is based on.

feedback.es: Su consejo es ser honesto: presentar la proyección como estimación y explicar en qué se basa.

origin.audio: Two colleagues are preparing a talk. One of them says: Start with the big picture, that the league doubled in three years. Then use one slide for each idea, and leave the limitation for last. If someone challenges the projection, just say that it is only an estimate, and explain what it is based on.

prompt.es: Completa: «Quiero destacar marzo, cuando el club alcanzó su máximo.»

feedback.es: I'd like to highlight + sustantivo introduce el dato al que quieres dirigir la atención del público.

origin.text: Every month on this slide shows growth. Among all of them, I would like to ___ March, when the club reached its peak of 900 fans.
